name: Захист фігур (2)
description:
Make sure that your pieces cannot be captured. Is one of your pieces under attack? Defend it by protecting it.

What do you have to do?
Protect an attacked piece. Start by finding the hanging piece (the piece that is at risk). Which of your pieces can your opponent capture? Then, figure out how to protect this piece with another piece. If you succeed, your piece will not be taken. This is a good way to avoid material loss.

examples.text: The knight is in danger. So let's cover this one quickly before the piece disappears from the board.
Once again the knight is in danger. This time the pawn fulfills the task of saving the knight.
How can White save the bishop? The bishop cannot run away, but luckily we can cover the bishop with the pawn.

texts: Find a way to save your rook.
